from AlgorithmImports import *


class TwoStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma_200 = self.SMA(self.spy, 200, Resolution.Daily)
        self.spy_sma_50 = self.SMA(self.spy, 50, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(200, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        self._update_market_state(data)

        required = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]
        if any(symbol not in data or data[symbol] is None for symbol in required):
            return

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if not (
            self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
            and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma_200 is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
        ):
            return

        spy_close = data[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data[self.aapl].Close

        spy_crosses_below_50 = (
            self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_50
            and spy_close > 0
            and spy_close < self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value
        )

        aapl_sell_reason = self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60

        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crosses_below_50:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        spy_crosses_above_200 = (
            self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200
            and spy_close > self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
        )

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crosses_above_200:
            shares = int(
                (0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) // spy_close
            )
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                shares = int(20000 // aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

    def _update_market_state(self, data: Slice):
        if self.spy in data and data[self.spy] is not None:
            self.previous_spy_close = data[self.spy].Close

            if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value

            if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value

        if self.aapl in data and data[self.aapl] is not None:
            aapl_close = data[self.aapl].Close

            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(
                ticker, Resolution.Daily

        self.spy_sma_200 = SimpleMovingAverage(200)
        self.spy_sma_50 = SimpleMovingAverage(50)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.prev_spy_close = None
        self.prev_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.prev_spy_sma_50 = None
        self.prev_aapl_rsi = None
        self.prev_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(200, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data):
        required = [self.spy, self.aapl,
                    self.symbols["IBM"], self.symbols["BAC"], self.symbols["AIG"]]

        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in required):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

        current_spy_sma_200 = float(self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value) \
            if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady else None
        current_spy_sma_50 = float(self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value) \
            if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady else None
        current_aapl_rsi = float(self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value) \
            if self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady else None

        self.spy_sma_200.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_close)
        self.spy_sma_50.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_close)
        self.aapl_rsi_14.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)

        if self.prev_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.prev_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            elif aapl_close > self.prev_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            self.prev_spy_close = spy_close
            self.prev_spy_sma_200 = (
                float(self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value)
                if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady else None
            )
            self.prev_spy_sma_50 = (
                float(self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value)
                if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady else None
            )
            self.prev_aapl_rsi = (
                float(self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value)
                if self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady else None
            )
            self.prev_aapl_close = aapl_close
            return

        spy_sma_200 = float(self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value)
        spy_sma_50 = float(self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value)
        aapl_rsi = float(self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value)

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0:
            if (
                self.prev_spy_close is not None
                and self.prev_spy_sma_50 is not None
                and self.prev_spy_close >= self.prev_spy_sma_50
                and spy_close < spy_sma_50
            ):
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0:
            if aapl_rsi > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0:
            if (
                self.prev_spy_close is not None
                and self.prev_spy_sma_200 is not None
                and self.prev_spy_close <= self.prev_spy_sma_200
                and spy_close > spy_sma_200
            ):
                target_value = 0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
                shares = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = shares

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0:
            if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                    shares = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_close))
                    if shares > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                        self.strategy_b_lot = shares

        self.prev_spy_close = spy_close
        self.prev_spy_sma_200 = spy_sma_200
        self.prev_spy_sma_50 = spy_sma_50
        self.prev_aapl_rsi = aapl_rsi
        self.prev_aapl_close = aapl_close

from AlgorithmImports import *


class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {
            ticker: self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
            for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        }

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma_200 = self.SMA(self.spy, 200, Resolution.Daily)
        self.spy_sma_50 = self.SMA(self.spy, 50, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(200, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        bars = {}

        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                self._update_state(data)
                return
            bars[ticker] = data.Bars[symbol]

        spy_close = bars["SPY"].Close
        aapl_close = bars["AAPL"].Close

        spy_sma_200_ready = self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
        spy_sma_50_ready = self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
        aapl_rsi_ready = self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady

        if not self.IsWarmingUp:
            strategy_a_sell = (
                self.strategy_a_shares > 0
                and spy_sma_50_ready
                and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma_50
                and spy_close < self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value
            )

            strategy_b_sell = (
                self.strategy_b_shares > 0
                and aapl_rsi_ready
                and self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60
            )

            if strategy_a_sell:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

            if strategy_b_sell:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

            strategy_a_buy = (
                self.strategy_a_shares == 0
                and spy_sma_200_ready
                and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma_200 is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200
                and spy_close > self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
            )

            strategy_b_buy = (
                self.strategy_b_shares == 0
                and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            )

            if strategy_a_buy:
                target_value = self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40
                quantity = int(target_value / spy_close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

            if strategy_b_buy and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self._update_state(data)

    def _update_state(self, data: Slice):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl) else None

        if spy_bar is not None:
            if self.previous_spy_close is not None:
                self.previous_spy_sma_200 = (
                    self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
                    if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady else None
                )
                self.previous_spy_sma_50 = (
                    self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value
                    if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady else None
                )

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

                ticker, Resolution.Daily
            ).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma_200 = SimpleMovingAverage(200)
        self.spy_sma_50 = SimpleMovingAverage(50)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=201)
        self.aapl_closes = deque(maxlen=2)

        self.prev_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.prev_spy_sma_50 = None
        self.prev_aapl_rsi = None

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        current_values = {}

        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                return
            current_values[ticker] = data.Bars[symbol]

        spy_bar = current_values["SPY"]
        aapl_bar = current_values["AAPL"]

        previous_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady else None
        previous_spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady else None
        previous_aapl_rsi = self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value if self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady else None

        if self.spy_closes and spy_bar.Close < self.spy_closes[-1]:
            pass

        self.spy_sma_200.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
        self.spy_sma_50.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_rsi_14.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        if self.aapl_closes:
            if aapl_bar.Close < self.aapl_closes[-1]:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.aapl_closes.append(aapl_bar.Close)

        if not (
            self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
            and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
            and previous_spy_sma_200 is not None
            and previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
            and previous_aapl_rsi is not None
            and len(self.spy_closes) >= 2
            and len(self.aapl_closes) >= 2
